rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something situated in, from, or generally related to the east.

example.english: This house is on the eastern side.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 uk1 hai6 dung1 min6 ge3

rows.note: Use this specifically when something faces or is oriented toward the east.

example.english: The window in my room has an eastern orientation.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaan1 fong2 go3 coeng1 hai6 hoeng3 dung1 ge3

rows.jyutping: jau4 dung1 min6 ceoi1 lei4 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this modifier for wind or weather blowing from the east, such as 由東面吹嚟嘅風.

example.english: An eastern wind is blowing today, and it has gotten much colder.
example.traditional: 今日有由東面吹嚟嘅風，凍咗好多。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 jau5 jau4 dung1 min6 ceoi1 lei4 ge3 fung1 dung3 zo2 hou2 do1
